title: Free AI Sales Roleplay for Small Teams: How to Start Practicing This Week
summary: How small sales teams can try AI sales roleplay free with Quotain's 7-day trial on Starter or Pro, a one-week practice plan and how to pick a plan.

Roleplay


On this page


Yes, a small sales team can try AI sales roleplay for free. Quotain's Starter and Pro plans both start with a 7-day free trial. You add a payment card at checkout, nothing is charged until the trial ends, and you are not billed if you cancel before day 7. During the trial you can build AI buyers from your company knowledge, run live voice practice calls and test custom scorecards with your team. To begin,[start for free](https://app.quotain.com/signup) . A week is enough to find out whether the buyer sounds like your prospects and whether the scores point to something a rep can fix.


## TL;DR


- Quotain's free trial: 7 days on Starter ($50 per seat a month) or Pro ($100 per seat a month), or $40 and $80 per seat a month billed yearly. You add a payment card at checkout, and nothing is charged until the trial ends.
- Use the trial week as a test: a baseline call, a harder retry on the weakest scorecard line, then the call stage your pipeline needs most.
- Peer roleplay with a free scenario library costs nothing and works well between AI calls.
- Choose Pro over Starter when you want more roleplay minutes, Slack or Microsoft Teams coaching, or the Analytics API. Talk to sales about Enterprise above 50 seats.

## A one-week practice plan for a small team


A trial week goes further when each call has a job. Pick one rep to run them, or have the team listen in and score along.


1. Baseline. Run a cold call on an easier setting. Read the scorecard and pick the single weakest line, such as the reason for the call or the meeting ask.
2. Pressure. Run the same stage on a harder setting and work only on that weak line. Compare the two transcripts at the moment the buyer pushed back.
3. Pipeline. Use the last call on the stage your deals need most this month: discovery if meetings stall after the first call, or negotiation if deals slip at price.


Then hold a 20-minute team review. Play the moment that cost the most points, agree on a better line, and have each rep say it out loud once.


## Free ways to keep practicing between AI calls


Peer roleplay costs nothing. Quotain's[free roleplay scenario library](https://www.quotain.com/scenarios) has copyable buyer briefs and scorecards, such as the[busy prospect cold call](https://www.quotain.com/scenarios/busy-prospect-cold-call) , the[too expensive objection](https://www.quotain.com/scenarios/too-expensive-objection) and the[price pressure negotiation](https://www.quotain.com/scenarios/price-pressure-negotiation) . One rep plays the buyer from the brief, one sells, and a third scores.


Other vendors offer free access too. Hyperbound, Outdoo and Yoodli list free plans or credits on their pricing pages, as recorded in our[AI sales roleplay software comparison](https://www.quotain.com/blog/best-ai-sales-roleplay-platforms) (checked November 3, 2026). Allowances change, so read each vendor's current pricing page.


### Can you use ChatGPT for free sales roleplay?


A general chatbot can play a buyer if you write a careful prompt with the buyer's role, company, goals and objections. It works for one rep testing an opener. A team gives up a few things: voice calls, a shared scorecard, consistent difficulty, and a record a manager can review. If the team wants to compare reps or track progress, dedicated software is easier.


## What to check in any free AI roleplay trial


- Does the buyer sound like your prospects, with the objections you hear on real calls?
- Does each score point to a moment in the transcript?
- Can the rep raise the difficulty and try again?
- Does the trial need a credit card, and what happens when it ends?
- How does the vendor handle your data? Quotain lists its controls and documents in its[Trust Center](https://trust.quotain.com/) .


## When to choose Starter, Pro or Enterprise


Starter costs $50 per seat a month, or $40 billed yearly, and adds 180 roleplay minutes per seat to a shared team pool each month. Pro costs $100 per seat a month, or $80 billed yearly, adds 480 minutes per seat, and includes Slack and Microsoft Teams apps, the Analytics API and priority support. Enterprise is custom for 50+ seats or custom scope. Every plan includes buyers in 30+ languages, your own scorecards, drills and certification, and connections to your CRM, call sources and docs. Keep a paid plan after the trial when one of these is true:


- The team wants to practice every week, with a drill from any moment in a call.
- You want reps graded on your own[sales call scorecard](https://www.quotain.com/blog/sales-call-scorecard) .
- Reps sell in more than one language. See[AI sales roleplay in 30+ languages](https://www.quotain.com/blog/multilingual-ai-sales-roleplay) .
- You want the last real call to become the next practice session with[real-call grading](https://www.quotain.com/product/real-call-grading) (on request on Pro, included on Enterprise).


## Frequently asked questions


### Is there free AI sales roleplay software?


Yes. Quotain's Starter and Pro plans start with a 7-day free trial. Hyperbound, Outdoo and Yoodli also list free plans or credits. Free allowances change often, so check each vendor's pricing page.


### Where can I get a free trial of sales roleplay software before purchasing?


You can[start Quotain's free trial](https://app.quotain.com/signup) on Starter or Pro. It builds a practice buyer from your company knowledge and runs for 7 days, so you can judge quality before you pay.


### Do I need a payment card for the Quotain free trial?


Yes. You add a payment card at checkout, and nothing is charged until the 7-day trial ends. Cancel before day 7 and you are not billed.


### Is AI sales roleplay worth it for a small team?


It is worth testing when reps lose deals at the same moments, such as the first objection or a discount request, and a manager has little time to roleplay. Run the free trial on that moment first. If the scores match what the manager hears on real calls, the practice is worth paying for.


### Which call types can I practice for free?


The Quotain free trial covers every call stage, including cold call, discovery and negotiation, plus stages you define. For ideas on what to practice, see our guides to[cold call role play](https://www.quotain.com/blog/cold-calling-roleplay) ,[discovery call roleplay](https://www.quotain.com/blog/discovery-call-roleplay) and[AI negotiation practice](https://www.quotain.com/blog/ai-negotiation-practice-software) .
